notes.text:
This update for webkit2gtk3 fixes the following issues:

  - CVE-2025-43343: Fixed an issue where processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process crash (bsc#1251975)
  - CVE-2025-43272: Fixed an issue where processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected Safari crash (bsc#1250439)
  - CVE-2025-43342: Fixed an issue where processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process crash (bsc#1250440)
  - CVE-2025-43356: Fixed an issue where websites may be able to access sensor information without user consent (bsc#1250441)
  - CVE-2025-43368: Fixed an issue where processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected Safari crash (bsc#1250442)
